create_adopt_optimizer: create an ADOPT optimizer with a learning rate and optional Nesterov momentum for training neural networks
scale_by_adopt_updates: scale gradient updates using the ADOPT algorithm with configurable decay rates and numerical stability eps
configure_adopt_clipping: configure ADOPT optimizer with gradient clipping to improve stability during early training stages
test_adopt_convergence: test the ADOPT optimizer on a simple quadratic function to verify convergence behavior
build_adopt_chain_transform: build a gradient transformation chain combining ADOPT scaling with a learning rate scheduler
